sources.title: Style IPAdapter for NoobAI-XL - v1.0 | NoobAI Controlnet | Civitai
sources.snippet: Style IPAdapter Finetune for NoobAI-XL This is a personal experiment to finetune the NoobAI's IP-Adapter to transfer drawing style, instead of subjects and compositions, from the reference image. It doesn't always work as well as expected, and I don't know how to further improve it besides gathering more data. (Also, one-image lora is quite viable nowadays). So I decided to release it as a toy ...
